third_party/minbpe — PROVENANCE
================================

fetch_date:

phase:              4 (baseline-7) — BPE baseline consolidation;
                    test-only independent round-trip cross-check role.
fairness_notes:     docs/benchmark/fairness/bpe.md

role
----
minbpe is a test-only **independent round-trip cross-check** for the `bpe`
baseline (SentencePiece BPE via the GPT-2 byte<->unicode bijection). It is NOT
a baseline, NOT on any measurement path, and NOT a bit-identical-token oracle:
SentencePiece's vocab and tie-breaks legitimately differ from minbpe's. Use:
  - Defence-in-depth at test time: drive minbpe (raw-byte BPE, no byte<->unicode
    mapping) and the `bpe` runner on the same tiny slice and assert BOTH
    round-trip to the exact input bytes. Because minbpe reaches those bytes by a
    completely independent code path, a divergence flags a harness/mapping bug a
    SentencePiece self-round-trip could miss. ONLY bytewise round-trip
    equivalence is asserted (not token identity). Test lives at
    tests/test_bpe_minbpe_crosscheck.py.
  - NOT linked into the runner binary .
  - Invoked from the orchestrator test path only (Python; via subprocess).

scope
-----
Full vendored tree, minus:
  - .git/         (no in-tree git history)
  - tests/        (minbpe upstream tests; not needed)
  - lecture.md    (educational markdown; not needed)

NOT used:
  - basic.py     → reference for the byte-level BPE algorithm (no regex
                    split, no special tokens). USED by the cross-check.
  - regex.py     → adds GPT-style regex pretokeniser; OUT OF SCOPE
                    (bytewise-correctness is the goal).
  - gpt4.py      → loads OpenAI GPT-4 tokenizer; OUT OF SCOPE.
  - train.py     → CLI driver; not invoked.

phase_0_compliance
------------------
- No git submodules : minbpe is a flat in-tree snapshot.
- No download-at-install: vendored at integration time.
- C++20 measurement language preserved: minbpe is Python; runs at test
  time only, not at measurement time.
- region (mirroring minbpe is an offline test-only cross-check.

reproducibility_caveat
----------------------
No upstream release tags. SHA pin is the reproducibility anchor.

bundled_snapshots
-----------------
None. minbpe is pure Python with no transitive C dependencies.
